8384992774.description:
X00789-00791. Stitched Panorama.
I'm on my knees with my camera ready. Image composed. Exposure measured. Focus set. My intension is to take a tree part pano to capture the symmetry of palms and buildnings and the "30" painted sign in the road in the morning light. Then enters a dog, a Westie, from nowhere, stops right in front of the camera staring at me for a few seconds and then continues on it's way. Absurd and surrealistic, just as Un Chien Andalou.
